title: Ensure nodev option set on /tmp partition
objective: Audit CIS checkpoint 1.1.2.1.2: Ensure nodev option set on /tmp partition

steps.name: Check if partition is a separate mount point
steps.function: 1. Check if the target partition ({{ partition }}) is a separate partition using command: `findmnt -kn {{ partition }}`. Expected result: output exists.

steps.name: Check if the fs_option is set on the partition
steps.function: 2. Check if the {{ fs_option }} option is set on {{ partition }} using command: `findmnt -kn {{ partition }} | grep -v {{ fs_option }}`. Expected result: no output returned.

reference_procedure:
- IF - a separate partition exists for /tmp, verify that the nodev option is set.
Run the following command to verify that the nodev mount option is set.
Example:
# findmnt -kn /tmp | grep -v nodev

Nothing should be returned
